description: An attribute-only splat cannot follow the attribute accesses of another one
notes: The spec's grammar (ExprTerm = ExprTerm Splat) allows a second splat operator after an attribute-only splat, which would apply it to the first splat's result. hashicorp/hcl rejects a .* inside an attribute-only splat as a nested splat (parseExpressionTraversals in hclsyntax/parser.go).
